overview: Built an automated field service and asset maintenance system for managing equipment faults, technician dispatch, repair operations, and preventive maintenance.

The workflow takes a machine alert or service request and turns it into a complete work order, including fault analysis, risk scoring, technician selection, scheduling, parts management, repair tracking, reporting, and asset health updates.

list: Receives IoT alerts and maintenance requests through webhooks
Identifies the affected asset and retrieves maintenance history
Validates alerts and prevents duplicate work orders
Analyzes equipment faults and probable causes using AI
Calculates operational risk and assigns incident priority
Creates structured work orders automatically
Creates dedicated Google Drive folders for service records and evidence
Searches qualified technicians based on skills, region, and certification
Checks technician availability through Google Calendar
Calculates travel time and ranks technicians automatically
Generates AI based dispatch recommendations
Routes critical jobs for supervisor approval when required
Assigns technicians and creates service appointments
Sends technician notifications through SMS and site updates through Gmail
Predicts required replacement parts and checks inventory availability
Reserves available parts for the assigned work order
Tracks technician arrival and repair progress
Processes technician service reports and repair details
Generates structured AI repair summaries
Reconciles reserved and actually used parts
Updates asset health, service history, and next maintenance date
Generates final maintenance reports automatically
Monitors assets for upcoming preventive maintenance
Creates preventive maintenance work orders for assets at risk
Updates maintenance and technician performance analytics

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined work order, technician notification, service report, and maintenance templates.

list: Work order information
Technician dispatch details
Site notifications
Service report structure
Maintenance recommendations

blocks.p: This keeps field service communication and maintenance records consistent across different assets, technicians, and locations.
Airtable or SmartSuite acts as the central asset, work order, technician, and maintenance tracking system.
Each work order is updated with:

list: Asset information
Fault category
Risk score
Assigned technician
Parts status
Repair progress
Resolution status
Asset health
Next maintenance date

result: A complete automated field service pipeline that turns an equipment alert into an analyzed, prioritized, assigned, repaired, documented, and completed work order without requiring maintenance teams to manually coordinate every step.
The system also keeps technician schedules, service records, parts usage, asset health, preventive maintenance, and operational analytics organized in one workflow.
